```{r}
library(RLHub)
library(RLSeq)
```

```{r}
base_url <- "https://rlbase-data.s3.amazonaws.com"
samples <- c("SRX1025894", "SRX1025896", "SRX2683605", "SRX2675009")
peak_urls <- paste0(base_url, "/peaks/", samples, "_hg38.broadPeak")

for (url in peak_urls) {
  dest <- paste0("../data/", strsplit(url, split = "/")[[1]][5])
  download.file(url, dest)
}
```

```{r}

rlr <- RLRanges(peaks = url, genome = "hg38", sampleName = "SRX2675009")
#rlr <- analyzeRLFS(rlr)
#rlr
```
